records.source: Are you going to enter the fishing contest tomorrow?
records.translation: Sasali ka ba sa paligsahan sa pangingisda bukas?

records.source: Thanks for a great year, @. I'm excited to tackle next year together.$l
records.translation: Salamat sa napakagandang taon, @. Sabik akong harapin ang susunod na taon kasama ka.$l

records.source: I'm feeling excited for a new year of farming, @!$h
records.translation: Sabik ako sa panibagong taon ng pagsasaka, @!$h

records.source: I may like the colder seasons, but by the end I'm always glad to see spring arrive.
records.translation: Maaaring mas gusto ko ang malalamig na panahon, pero sa huli ay lagi akong natutuwang dumating ang tagsibol.

records.source: Aren't you glad winter's over, honey? Things seem more hopeful now.
records.translation: Hindi ka ba natutuwang tapos na ang taglamig, mahal? Parang mas may pag-asa na ngayon.

records.source: Don't forget to look for wild horseradish, leeks and dandelions while you're out there!
records.translation: Huwag kalimutang maghanap ng ligaw na horseradish, sibuyas-pranses, at dandelion habang nasa labas ka!

records.source: I'm so happy to see some greenery after that long white winter.
records.translation: Napakasaya kong makakita ng luntiang paligid matapos ang napakahabang puting taglamig.

records.source: Wow, my skin is pale... I guess I'd better help you with some farm work this season.
records.translation: Wow, ang putla ng balat ko... Mukhang kailangan kitang tulungan sa ilang gawain sa bukid ngayong panahon.

records.source: Let's plant some healthy vegetables this spring.$h
records.translation: Magtanim tayo ng ilang masustansiyang gulay ngayong tagsibol.$h

records.source: I'm looking forward to a beautiful year on %farm farm.$h
records.translation: Inaasam ko ang isang magandang taon sa Bukid na %farm.$h

records.source: Hey @. Let's work hard today!
records.translation: Hoy, @. Magsikap tayo ngayon!

records.source: *sniff* ... My doze is stubbed up... allergies.
records.translation: *singhot*... Barado ang ilong bo... mga allergy.

records.source: Maybe I'll learn a new skill this year...
records.translation: Baka matuto ako ng bagong kasanayan ngayong taon...

records.source: It's a good time of year to do some stargazing.
records.translation: Magandang panahon ito para magmasid sa mga bituin.

records.source: Oh man... I could go for some chocolate cake.
records.translation: Naku... Sarap sanang kumain ng keyk na tsokolate.

records.source: You must know by now that summer is my favorite season.$h
records.translation: Siguradong alam mo na ngayon na tag-init ang paborito kong panahon.$h

records.source: Nothing pairs so well with summer like a nice sweet wine. Don't you think, honey?
records.translation: Walang mas babagay sa tag-init kaysa sa masarap at matamis na alak. Hindi ba, mahal?

records.source: Are you growing any melons this summer?
records.translation: May itinatanim ka bang mga melon ngayong tag-init?

records.source: I'm going to stay inside as much as possible this summer.
records.translation: Mananatili ako sa loob hangga't maaari ngayong tag-init.

records.source: Make sure you don't get sunburnt, honey... That can really damage your skin.
records.translation: Tiyaking hindi ka mapaso sa araw, mahal... Talagang makapipinsala iyon sa balat mo.

records.source: One of the main things I miss about the ocean is the fresh fish.
records.translation: Isa sa mga pangunahing bagay na hinahanap-hanap ko sa karagatan ay ang sariwang isda.

records.source: I always have the most energy in the summer.
records.translation: Lagi akong pinakamasigla tuwing tag-init.

records.source: Summer always makes me want to eat more barbecue.
records.translation: Lagi akong ginaganahang kumain ng mas maraming inihaw tuwing tag-init.

records.source: Phew! It's hot but it feels great, doesn't it?#$e#Maybe we'll see some wild parrots today.
records.translation: Hay! Mainit pero ang sarap sa pakiramdam, hindi ba?#$e#Baka makakita tayo ng ilang ligaw na loro ngayon.

records.source: What's on my agenda today... hmmm... #$e#I think I see some spicy pretzel snacks and a couple of 'cold boys' on the horizon.
records.translation: Ano ang balak ko ngayon... hmmm... #$e#Parang natatanaw ko ang ilang maanghang na pretzel at dalawang “malamig na bote”.

records.source: I'm glad I still work at the clinic... It's an important service for the community.
records.translation: Natutuwa akong nagtatrabaho pa rin ako sa klinika... Mahalaga ito sa komunidad.

records.source: I hope we're growing pumpkins this year.$h
records.translation: Sana nagtatanim tayo ng mga kalabasa ngayong taon.$h

records.source: I'm craving cake.#$e#But not just any cake... it has to be pink.
records.translation: Gustong-gusto kong kumain ng keyk.#$e#Pero hindi basta anumang keyk... kailangan itong kulay-rosas.

records.source: Breathe deep... can you smell that? That tells me it's mushroom season.
records.translation: Huminga nang malalim... naaamoy mo ba iyon? Ibig sabihin niyan, panahon na ng mga kabute.

records.source: It's so peaceful out here on the farm. I never appreciated nature that much living in town.
records.translation: Napakatahimik dito sa bukid. Hindi ko gaanong pinahalagahan ang kalikasan noong nakatira ako sa bayan.

records.source: My mother used to always make this delicious pumpkin soup in the fall.
records.translation: Dati ay laging nagluluto ang nanay ko ng napakasarap na Sabaw na Kalabasa tuwing taglagas.

records.source: I could sure go for some wine.
records.translation: Sarap sanang uminom ng alak.

records.source: Ah... Fall. The warm sun drifts low in the sky, casting long shadows over waving fields of gold.#$e#It's a beautiful time of year, don't you think?
records.translation: Ah... Taglagas. Mababa ang mainit na araw sa langit at nag-iiwan ng mahahabang anino sa mga ginintuang bukiring hinahaplos ng hangin.#$e#Napakagandang panahon ng taon, hindi ba?

records.source: I feel weak... I need some protein.$s
records.translation: Nanghihina ako... Kailangan ko ng protina.$s

records.source: I wonder what's going on in the rest of the world? We're really secluded here.
records.translation: Ano kaya ang nangyayari sa ibang bahagi ng mundo? Talagang liblib tayo rito.

records.source: I drank a super-food smoothie this morning and I feel aaah-mazing!$h
records.translation: Uminom ako ng smoothie na punô ng napakasustansiyang sangkap kaninang umaga at napakaganda ng pakiramdam ko!$h

records.source: I think there might be a new species of fungus growing behind my mini-fridge.#$e#Ah well, 'tis the season, right?
records.translation: Mukhang may bagong uri ng halamang-singaw na tumutubo sa likod ng Munting Pridyider ko.#$e#Ah, ayos lang, panahon naman nito, hindi ba?

records.source: Spring is coming soon. I'm really looking forward to having rhubarb pie.
records.translation: Malapit na ang tagsibol. Sabik na sabik akong kumain ng Pai ng Rubarbo.

records.source: Remember when we played that 'Prairie King' game together, in my room? Those were good times.$h
records.translation: Naaalala mo noong magkasama nating nilaro ang 'Hari ng Kapatagan' sa kuwarto ko? Masasayang panahon iyon.$h

records.source: I was just thinking about the time you helped me open a jar of pickles.$h#$e#We've come a long way since then.$l
records.translation: Iniisip ko lang noong tinulungan mo akong magbukas ng garapon ng atsara.$h#$e#Napakalayo na ng narating natin mula noon.$l

records.source: I always start craving salad in the winter... Inconvenient, I know.
records.translation: Lagi akong gustong-gustong kumain ng salad tuwing taglamig... Hindi praktikal, alam ko.

records.source: I'm going to do a lot of reading this winter.
records.translation: Marami akong babasahin ngayong taglamig.

records.source: I wonder what Sam's up to? We used to be really good friends.
records.translation: Ano kaya ang pinagkakaabalahan ni Sam? Dati, matalik kaming magkaibigan.

records.source: Winter is flu season, so work is probably going to be a lot more stressful. Sorry in advance if I'm grouchy.
records.translation: Panahon ng trangkaso ang taglamig, kaya malamang na mas mabigat ang trabaho. Paumanhin na agad kung mainitin ang ulo ko.

records.source: I think I might do some writing this winter. There's not much else to do, anyway.
records.translation: Baka magsulat ako ngayong taglamig. Wala rin namang gaanong ibang magagawa.

records.source: I hope my grandparents are doing okay. They used to rely on my help quite a bit. You know, with lifting heavy objects or whatever.
records.translation: Sana ayos lang ang mga lolo't lola ko. Dati, madalas silang umaasa sa tulong ko. Alam mo na, sa pagbubuhat ng mabibigat na bagay at kung ano-ano pa.

records.source: I've given up on being a musician. I'm a family man now!
records.translation: Sumuko na ako sa pagiging musikero. Pamilyadong tao na ako!

records.source: Whoops, my hair is frozen solid again.$s
records.translation: Ay, nagyelo na naman nang husto ang buhok ko.$s

records.source: There's a wide, wide world out there... but I'd rather stay in my room.
records.translation: Napakalawak ng mundong naroon sa labas... pero mas gusto kong manatili sa kuwarto ko.

records.source: #$c .5#I got up early to do a little star-gazing.#$e#I hope you don't mind if I spend some time on my projects today, honey.
records.translation: #$c .5#Maaga akong bumangon para magmasid nang kaunti sa mga bituin.#$e#Sana ayos lang sa iyo kung gugugol ako ng kaunting oras sa mga proyekto ko ngayon, mahal.

records.source: #$c .5#I got up a little before you and fed David Jr. He's very active this morning.#$e#I hope you don't mind the guinea pig smell.
records.translation: #$c .5#Nauna akong bumangon nang kaunti at pinakain ko si David Jr. Napakasigla niya ngayong umaga.#$e#Sana hindi ka naiilang sa amoy ng dagang-gini.

records.source: #$c .5#Go ahead and start your day, honey. I'm just putting on my make-up.#$e#Have any plans for the day?
records.translation: #$c .5#Sige, simulan mo na ang araw mo, mahal. Naglalagay lang ako ng makeup.#$e#May plano ka ba ngayon?

records.source: #$c .5#One of these days I'll have to do your portrait.#$e#The view from this window is inspiring, don't you think?
records.translation: #$c .5#Isa sa mga araw na ito, kailangan kong iguhit ang larawan mo.#$e#Nakagaganyak ang tanawin mula sa bintanang ito, hindi ba?

records.source: #$c .5#I always wanted my very own library. This is so charming.$h#$e#I like to do a little reading first thing in the morning. It gets my brain into gear.
records.translation: #$c .5#Matagal ko nang gustong magkaroon ng sarili kong aklatan. Napakaganda nito.$h#$e#Gusto kong magbasa nang kaunti pagkagising sa umaga. Napapagana nito ang isip ko.

records.source: #$c .5#I'm debating whether I should work or just read comics all day.#$e#Hey, do we have any pizza in the freezer? I'm hungry.
records.translation: #$c .5#Pinag-iisipan ko kung magtatrabaho ako o magbabasa na lang ng komiks buong araw.#$e#Hoy, may pizza ba tayo sa freezer? Gutom ako.

records.source: #$c .5#No air-traffic this morning, honey. But it's still fun to break out the equipment now and then.#$e#I'm working on a new model plane. It's so much more relaxing here than in my old apartment.
records.translation: #$c .5#Walang trapiko sa himpapawid ngayong umaga, mahal. Pero masaya pa ring ilabas paminsan-minsan ang mga kagamitan.#$e#Gumagawa ako ng bagong miniaturang eroplano. Mas nakapagrerelaks dito kaysa sa dati kong apartment.

records.source: #$c .5#I think I might do some writing today.#$e#Will you be okay without my help?
records.translation: #$c .5#Baka magsulat ako ngayon.#$e#Ayos ka lang ba kahit hindi kita tulungan?

records.source: #$c .5#Don't ever let me get lazy. I want to stay in good shape for you!#$e#There's lots of room here to do my exercises. I'm making more progress than ever!
records.translation: #$c .5#Huwag mong hayaang maging tamad ako. Gusto kong manatiling malakas para sa iyo!#$e#Malawak ang lugar dito para mag-ehersisyo. Mas mabilis ang pag-unlad ko ngayon kaysa dati!

records.source: #$c .5#The old guitar... I don't have as much drive to play it anymore. That's fine.#$e#What's on your agenda today?
records.translation: #$c .5#Itong lumang gitara... Hindi na ako gaanong sabik tumugtog nito. Ayos lang iyon.#$e#Ano ang balak mo ngayon?

records.source: I'm going to spend some time with the parrot today. It breaks my heart that he'll never fly again.$u
records.translation: Maglalaan ako ng oras para sa loro ngayon. Masakit sa loob kong hindi na siya kailanman makalilipad.$u

records.source: #$c .5#Beer or cider? Sometimes life can be challenging.#$e#Hi, @. I'll just hang out in here today and uh... maybe sweep the floor a little bit or something.
records.translation: #$c .5#Serbesa o cider? Mahirap talaga kung minsan ang buhay.#$e#Kumusta, @. Tatambay lang ako rito ngayon at, uh... baka magwalis nang kaunti o kung ano man.

records.source: Ah, it's more humid today with the rain... I feel a lot more comfortable.
records.translation: Ah, mas mahalumigmig ngayon dahil sa ulan... Mas komportable ang pakiramdam ko.

records.source: The sound of the rain reminds me of the sewers... it's comforting.#$e#The sewers were my refuge... I felt safe there. But don't worry... I feel the same way about my new home, too.
records.translation: Ipinapaalala sa akin ng tunog ng ulan ang mga Imburnal... nakapagpapakalma iyon.#$e#Kanlungan ko ang mga Imburnal... Ligtas ang pakiramdam ko roon. Pero huwag kang mag-alala... Ganoon din ang nararamdaman ko sa bago kong tahanan.

records.source: I wish I could help you on the farm, but I can't go out in the sun...
records.translation: Sana makatulong ako sa iyo sa bukid, pero hindi ako makalabas sa sikat ng araw...

records.source: Hi, @. Welcome home. You look like you've been working hard out there!$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Maligayang pag-uwi. Mukhang nagsikap ka nang husto roon sa labas!$h

records.source: On a day like this, I can enjoy the outdoors with you. This is really nice!$h#$b#Just let me know if you see anyone coming, so I can hide.$u
records.translation: Sa araw na ganito, maaari akong masiyahan sa labas kasama ka. Napakaganda nito!$h#$b#Sabihin mo lang kung may nakikita kang paparating para makapagtago ako.$u

records.source: Where am I supposed to sleep...?$s
records.translation: Saan ako dapat matulog...?$s

records.source: I wasn't able to sleep well last night...$s
records.translation: Hindi ako nakatulog nang maayos kagabi...$s

records.source: I had to sleep on the floor last night...$s
records.translation: Kinailangan kong matulog sa sahig kagabi...$s

records.source: Did something happen to our bed...?$s
records.translation: May nangyari ba sa kama natin...?$s
